newsitem.title: USA: Plane lands safely in Los Angeles after engine failure.
newsitem.headline: Plane lands safely in Los Angeles after engine failure.

text.p: A United Airlines passenger jet returned to Los Angeles to make an emergency landing on Sunday when one of its engines lost power soon after the plane took off for Hawaii.

The 747 jumbo jet landed safely and no injuries were reported among the 400 passengers on board, Los Angeles fire department officials said. They said a problem developed with a compressor in one of the jet's four engines.
Passengers were put on other flights to Hawaii.
United Airlines is a subsidiary of Chicago-based UAL Corp.
